tier1.text: The midbrain coordinates what sight, hearing and touch tell us about the space around us. The midbrain forms the top of the brain stem, which connects to the spinal cord. The midbrain has four bumps called colliculi, Latin for “little hills.” The upper pair, the superior colliculi, are involved in turning the eyes toward a sound or touch.

quotes.quote: The tectum is composed of four bumps known as the colliculi (singular = colliculus), which means “little hill” in Latin.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The upper pair, the superior colliculi, are involved in turning the eyes toward a sound or touch.

quotes.quote: The superior colliculus is the superior pair and combines sensory information about visual space, auditory space, and somatosensory space. Activity in the superior colliculus is related to orienting the eyes to a sound or touch stimulus.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
